thread:
incident-bot: 🔔 PagerDuty: SRE on-call paged — high rate-limit violations detected for org `zephyrus` (org-4271). Alert: org quota exhausted, 429 spike.

maya (sre): I'm on it. Quick summary pls: customer impact, any deploys?

elliot (support): Customer reported spike in failed calls to chat endpoint ~10:18 UTC. They say UX rate limit banner visible to users. No deploys from their side reported.

zoe (customer-ops): Customer contact: ops@zephyrus.ai. Reporting major degradation on search-like flows (heavy embedding + rerank). They see lots of retries.

raj (eng-infra): Metrics: spikes in RL rejections at 10:16, saturation of per-org tokens/s. p50/p95 latency unchanged. Model pods healthy. Looks like sustained burst above their usual 20rpm org limit. Dashboard: https://console.redwood-internal/telemetry/orgs/4271/rl

maya (sre): Possible mitigations: 1) Temporary org-level rate bump, 2) Disable expensive rerank feature (feature flag), 3) Route to fallback model with lower cost. I'll coordinate.

sophie (oncall): I'll take primary exec. @maya please hand off when you need to sleep.

maya (sre): Action 1 — apply hotfix: raise org rate cap to 60rpm for 20m, tokens-per-minute adjusted. Executing admin CLI now.

raj (eng-infra): Got it. Command I ran:```bash
redwood-admin org-rate update --org-id org-4271 --limit 60 --window 60s --reason "emergency surge mitigation" --expires-in 20m
```
API response:```json
{"status":"ok","org_id":"org-4271","new_limit":60,"expires_in":"20m","who":"raj"}
```

elliot (support): Noted. Telling customer it's a temporary uplift and we'll monitor.

zoe (customer-ops): Customer update sent: "We've applied a temporary rate increase while we investigate. We'll follow up with root cause and a timeline."

maya (sre): Action 2 — toggle off heavy reranking for org. Pushing feature gate now. Raj, can you flip feature flag `rerank-v2` to off for org-4271?

raj (eng-infra): Done. Command:```bash
redwood-feature toggle --org org-4271 --flag rerank-v2 --state off --reason "reduce heavy downstream calls during surge"
```
Result: success.

maya (sre): Action 3 — traffic shaping: divert requests over 50 tokens to fallback gpt-slim model for this org. Implemented via routing rule. Rule snippet:```yaml
routing_rule:
  org: org-4271
  match: "request.tokens > 50"
  action: "route_to: gpt-slim-v1"
  ttl: 20m
```

raj (eng-infra): Routing in place. Observability: rejecting rate dropped by ~85% and error surface for org down to baseline within 60s. See: https://console.redwood-internal/telemetry/orgs/4271/rl?range=15m

elliot (support): Customer reports immediate improvement. No more banners. They can continue ops.

maya (sre): Nice. Logging incident steps and IDs: HOTFIX-4271-2026-03-17. Captured audit IDs for rate-change and feature-toggle.

zoe (customer-ops): Raising follow-up: coordinate with biz-dev on whether org needs longer-term uplift or surge protection product.

maya (sre): Next steps: - Keep uplift pinned for 20m (auto-expire). - Monitor for recurrence for 4 hours. - Collect logs and traffic pattern for replay. - If reoccurs, propose permanent quota change or burst window config.

sophie (oncall): Handoff: maya, I'll be on hand for the next 40m. If you need to sign out, update pager status.

maya (sre): I'm staying on until metrics stable for 15m. Then I'll handoff to sophie.

raj (eng-infra): Created short-lived runbook entry: "org-4271 surge playbook" with commands used and rollback steps.

elliot (support): Filing customer incident ticket linking to HOTFIX-4271-2026-03-17 and actions taken.

incident-bot: ✅ Auto-note: Hotfix applied (ID HOTFIX-4271-2026-03-17). All automated changes have audit logs attached.

maya (sre): Final check 10:29 UTC — rates stable, no new 429s in last 5m. Marking incident as mitigated; will create a short postmortem and recommend permanent surge policy for this org.

zoe (customer-ops): Customer follow-up scheduled in 30m to confirm satisfaction and next steps.

sophie (oncall): Taking over primary. If anything flares, ping me. Otherwise I'll close thread after postmortem draft. :white_check_mark:
